verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents capturing vendor receipts by mobile scan, drag-and-drop upload, or an email inbox, and paying invoices directly from sevDesk through connected bank accounts. Nothing in the evidence shows approval routing, and the payment evidence describes a one-off direct payment, not scheduling payments for a future date. missing for 10: approval routing/workflow for bills, scheduled or future-dated payments, evidence that capture-approve-pay is one integrated workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow

citations.quote: Scan your receipts with the mobile app, upload them using drag & drop or send them directly to your sevdesk inbox.
pay your invoices directly from sevdesk
Map invoices directly to your bank payments.
